scripts.build: bun run build:api && bun run build:web
scripts.build:api: cd apps/api && bunx wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.lint: bun run lint:js && bun run lint:format && bun run secrets
scripts.test: bun run test:api && bun run test:web
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:api && bun run typecheck:web
scripts.typecheck:api: cd apps/api && bun run typegen --check && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
